data.name: Amilah
data.gender_notes: Amilah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘amila’, meaning ‘to work’ or ‘to labor’. This name signifies diligence and hard work, and is often given to girls who are expected to be industrious and dedicated. The name Amilah carries the meaning “Work, labor, industrious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amilah usually hope their child will grow to embody work, labor, industrious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is believed to have a pure and trustworthy nature
data.etymology: Amilah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Work, labor, industrious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amilah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

Given the name Amilah is often considered a call to be productive and contribute to society, making it an admirable and inspiring choice for parents.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Amilah resonates with the principles of serving Allah and living a purposeful life. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) emphasized the importance of working diligently for the pleasure of Allah and striving to be productive members of society. Therefore, the name Amilah embodies a dedication to serving both humanity and the Divine, instilling a sense of purpose and meaning in the lives of those who bear this name.
